[Português](index.qmd) · [API documentation](documentation.qmd)

Research notebooks on synthetic time series, known generating mechanisms and
explanation evaluation. Browse the experiment folders below or use site search.

Pages display the code, figures, tables and saved outputs from versioned notebooks
under `experiments/`. Publishing does not execute experiments. Reproduction records
remain inside each notebook.

The website navigation and documentation are available in English and Portuguese.
Research notebooks retain their original language. The report is the original
English LaTeX manuscript.
